name: village
comment: Tales-Weaver-style village vertical-slice map. Consumed by the integration agent to build a tilemap::TilemapWorld + ECS entities. COORDINATE CONVENTION (docs/00, bridge_demo): world unit == 1 cell == PPU48 px, +Y up. HybridRenderer maps cell (cx,cy) -> world (x=cx, yBottom=-cy). So to place something at world Y=W, set cellY=-W. Rows below are listed in SCREEN order (top row = smallest world-... i.e. most negative cellY / largest world Y). All tile roles map to the PNGs from make_tiles.ps1.

layers.name: ground
layers.comment: Base ground layer (layer 0). Every cell in bounds gets a ground tile so there are no background gaps. 'fill' is the default role; 'cells' rectangles override it. Water cells are impassable; the creek runs vertically (constant cellX band) so the bridge crosses it E-W.

rects.note: main N-S dirt road down the village center
the creek: a vertical stream (worldX 5..6) crossed by the bridge
stone plaza (worldY 3..6) holding the fountain + statue

slopes.comment: Gentle hill on the west edge. baseHeightLevel=0 (flush with ground so no gap); SlopeType::GentleN gives the depth ramp. Visual rise handled like bridge_demo SlopeGroundY: rises from world Y=-2 (bottom) to world Y=+2 (top), maxRise=2 units.

layers.name: bridge
layers.comment: Bridge deck lives on its own TilemapWorld/layer so it extracts to the World1 band (floor1) like bridge_demo. It spans the creek E-W (worldX 4..7) at the cross-road (worldY 0). Cells carry ColumnFlags OneWayBridge|Bridge.

props.comment: 3D village monument on the plaza (worldX -7, worldY 5). AnchorBiased so characters sort in front/behind by foot Y.
3D fountain lower on the plaza (worldX -8, worldY 3.5).

player.comment: Player starts on the road south of the crossroads (worldY -3). WASD to move, 8-dir animator.

npcs.comment: Village chief stands by the fountain/statue on the plaza.
Traveling merchant near the crossroads, just west of the creek/bridge approach.
Gate guard on the far (east) side of the bridge, across the creek.
